name: agent:core
description: Core: orchestration, process, CORE.md, integration

name: agent:engine
description: Engine: loop, camera, input, iso math, atlas, audio, RNG, build config

name: agent:world
description: World: map generation, tiles, regions, track graph and geometry, pathfinding

name: agent:gameplay
description: Gameplay: simulation, economy, trains and traffic, content data, save format

name: agent:rendering
description: Rendering: world, trains, overview and effects renderers

name: agent:uiux
description: UI/UX: DOM panels and screens, editor, strings

name: agent:art
description: Art: sprite generators, asset pipeline, art direction

name: agent:qa
description: QA: review of a change against its issue and the rules

name: agent:verification
description: Verification: deterministic tests for math and logic

name: type:epic
description: A feature with a spec, split into tasks

name: type:task
description: One role, one branch, one pull request

name: type:bug
description: Reproducible defect with logs and acceptance criteria

name: type:test
description: Adds or fixes tests only

name: type:docs
description: Documentation only

name: type:chore
description: Tooling, CI, repository hygiene

name: type:triage
description: Decide what happens to existing work

name: status:triage
description: New; Core has not classified it

name: status:ready
description: Meets the definition of ready; can start

name: status:in-progress
description: An agent is working on it

name: status:in-review
description: QA and verification running, or pull request open

name: status:blocked
description: Waiting on another issue or a failure that needs its own fix

name: needs:decision
description: Waits on the author

name: scope:cross
description: Pull request allowed to cross role scope; set by Core only

name: priority:p0
description: Breaks develop or main; drop everything

name: priority:p1
description: Next up

name: priority:p2
description: Planned

name: priority:p3
description: Some day
